name: torgge-skills
description: Personal collection of AI-agent skills as installable plugins for Claude Code and Cursor.

plugins.name: draw-io
plugins.description: Generate editable draw.io diagrams and export them as house-themed SVG (embedded XML, readable in light/dark). Mermaid or XML authoring, ELK auto-layout, browser-URL output.

plugins.name: konsist-run-skill
plugins.description: Run-skill for the Konsist Kotlin static-analysis library: a container-first driver that scopes Kotlin and asserts architecture rules via the Konsist API, plus the from-source build gotchas.

plugins.name: check-after-implementation
plugins.description: After any code implementation: run quality + security gates in a fix-and-recheck loop until blocking targets are green; same gate set must run as a blocking GitHub Actions job.
